visualReview.notes: Inspected 11 current portable renders including the retained 1024×640 summary. The irregular mapped outer envelope and open courtyard, four pointed court iwans, recessed eastern outer entry, eight capped minarets, cream portal borders, pale flat roofs and two rows of courtyard niche fields are present. The low roof no longer crosses the outer entrance. Fine calligraphy, historic tile artwork, furnishings, detached structures and large unsupported domes are omitted.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected 11 current shared-material and geographic-flat views, including the footprint overlay. Six existing 256² graphs provide brick, raw limestone, mosaic tile, lime plaster, marble and plain wood; seven merged roles include local opaque glazing. Metric UVs and linear vertex tints are used, with no embedded images or unique atlas. Shared graphs are read once and model geometry is disposed on eviction. The 123 surrounding host buildings remain separate; courtyard ground is host content. The flat overlay checks pose and replacement, while the retained standard DEM fixture checks approximate contact.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected 27 current medium-fi views: Economy/High, noon/late light, street/block/skyline, silhouette, six details, four matched LODs and four transitions. Courtyard void, five portal frames and capped tower silhouette persist through the LODs. Skyline drops small doors and niches and uses six-sided tower profiles; district restores coarse closed fields, portal borders and galleries; street restores two-tier niche rhythm and inner vault ribs; closeup restores more facets and original coarse diamond centers. The distant footing ribbon extends below the sampled terrain minimum without extra triangles. Whole views retain the model; some detail cameras intentionally crop tower tops. Context houses are synthetic. Physical-device and full-city timing remain pending.
